en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a waterfront settlement with small boats docked along wooden piers, low-rise houses and shops facing the water, and a hill with larger buildings or a compound on top in the background. The style is late 19th–early 20th century. French caption text appears at the bottom center, with publisher and photographer credits at the lower edge and a circular seal on the left. A modern website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) overlays part of the image.
